source_facts.forbidden_projection: No subject, content, reason, resultSummary, amount, actualAmount, ownerEmployeeId, recipient, evidence, detail, stack, unknown DTO field, raw object, or JSON.stringify output reaches page text, HTML, or attributes.

other_monitor_projection_boundary.rule: The hub composes monitor-only features/projections, including the dedicated three-field P016 projection, without embedding any route Page.vue or business mutation feature. P008 remains on the attendance-monitor contract and P009 on its independent route.

p015_dedicated_monitor.rule: P015 remains an explicit dedicated monitor route and is not omitted from the architecture merely because it is not composed into this shared hub.

source_facts.mutation_boundary: The technical page performs only projection GET and technical refresh. It provides no create, act, approve, accept, certify, execute, mutation URL, business action, or fabricated allowedActions authority.
